authority: Selects process, evidence, and approval gates only. It cannot choose product priority, design direction, membership, money, participant authority, or release truth.
mutation_rule: A time_based or proactive route that requests mutation terminates approval_required and requires a new approved effect route.
skill_rule: Only active repository skill IDs may be selected. Disabled, quarantined, degraded, or platform-injected skills may be observed but cannot establish governed acceptance.
retry_rule: Three identical external blockers terminate with a continuation packet; retries without a changed hypothesis are not progress.
